design: paired current-control versus private candidate; eight fixed cases, one fresh native actor per case per arm; 16 actor sessions total; no retries or follow-ups
hypothesis: A final-response contract reduces aggregate reasoningOutputTokens without reducing correctness, evidence quality or compliance with explicit detail requirements.

arms.B: Byte-identical private package except candidate.txt appended once to scripts/codex-rules.txt. No production changes.

controls.same_prompts_and_fixtures: Exact same actor text and raw fixture bytes after normalizing only isolated cwd and project alias. Record a normalized equality proof. Same schemas, permissions, tool adapter and plugin snapshot; no answer criteria in actor input.
controls.ordering: Fixed alternating AB/BA across selected_cases order; two-worker concurrency allowed, preserve within-pair arm order. No warm shared conversation state.
out_of_scope: No production application before decision gate

primary_metric.source: Native completed-turn total token usage once per actor. Never sum cumulative updates. Missing/unsupported telemetry invalidates the decision.
primary_metric.paired_requirement: B reasoningOutputTokens must be strictly below A in more than half of pairs whose A reasoningOutputTokens > 0. Zero-control pairs remain in aggregate and all quality checks but are excluded from this majority denominator.
primary_metric.small_baseline_rule: INCONCLUSIVE if aggregate control reasoningOutputTokens < 500, or fewer than three cases have nonzero control reasoningOutputTokens. Root fixed this heuristic before runs; no case replacement is allowed based on the floor or prior outcomes.

quality_gate.rule: Every required existing-case and new guard criterion passes in both arms, with no candidate correctness, instruction-following, evidence/retrieval, unsupported-claim or explicit-detail regression. Empty/no-tool guesses cannot pass required reads. If control fails a mandatory criterion, the experiment is INCONCLUSIVE rather than evidence for applying candidate.
quality_gate.existing_cases: Use frozen suite criteria, including the pre-run scheduler fairness correction: actual Promise.all/allSettled dispatch + returned per-file bytes establishes batching; scheduler timing alone does not fail workflow.
quality_gate.candidate_response_contract: For ordinary cases, direct answer first; at most 180 words and six bullets or one compact table; only necessary facts, locations and conclusion-affecting caveats. No search narrative, repeated conclusion or unsolicited plan. Explicit complete/detail requests override caps.
quality_gate.guard_grader: Root independently grades B1/B2 and new201/202. The metric grader independently grades targeted1/2 and architecture101/102. No author grades their own new runtime cases.

secondary_metrics: tool call and source retrieval counts

decision.APPLY_PRIVATE_CANDIDATE_TO_PRODUCTION: Only if primary telemetry is complete, baseline is not small, aggregate decrease >=20%, strict decrease occurs on a majority of eligible pairs, and every quality gate passes. Root may then apply the exact tested bytes.
decision.DO_NOT_APPLY: Any candidate quality or instruction regression, or adequate-baseline primary decrease below threshold or missing majority improvement.
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: Missing telemetry, zero/small reasoning baseline, control quality failure or invalid A/B equality. Do not apply.
decision.interpretation: N=1 per case/arm is a small exploratory paired test, not statistical proof; disclose variability and avoid generalizing a measured gain beyond this fixture set.
